Wat je eet, merk je in je training. Je h: What you eat shows in your training. You don't have to weigh everything, but a few simple habits give you more energy and faster recovery.
Eet één tot drie uur van tevoren iets me: One to three hours before, eat something with carbs and a little protein, such as oats with yoghurt or a slice of bread with egg. Training early in the morning? A banana is often enough.
Na een zware sessie helpen eiwitten je s: After a hard session, protein helps your muscles recover and carbs refill your energy. A regular meal within a few hours works fine.

Je eerste Hyrox is spannend. Het goede n: Your first Hyrox is exciting. The good news: you don't need to be a marathon runner or a powerlifter. With a smart plan you'll get through it just fine. Five tips to get started.
Een Hyrox-race is acht keer een kilomete: A Hyrox race is eight one-kilometre runs, each followed by a functional workout. The format is the same all over the world, so you know exactly what you're training for.
Train je rennen als je moe bent: Train your running when you're tired
Het lastige van Hyrox is niet de kilomet: The hard part of Hyrox isn't the kilometre itself, but running on legs that just pushed a sled. So practise runs straight after strength or conditioning work, so your body gets used to that feeling.
SkiErg, sled push en pull, burpee broad: SkiErg, sled push and pull, burpee broad jumps, rowing, farmers carry, sandbag lunges and wall balls. If you know the movements, you won't waste energy on technique on race day.
Ga niet te hard van start. De eerste kil: Don't go out too fast. The first kilometre feels easy, the last station doesn't.
Kies een tempo dat je acht keer vol kunt: Pick a pace you can hold eight times. Run the first ones too fast and you'll pay for it at the wall balls.
Take the week before your race a bit easier. Sleep well, eat as you're used to and try nothing new on race day: no new shoes, no new gel.

Te vroeg trekken met je armen: Pulling with your arms too early
Je armen zijn touwen, geen hijskraan. La: Your arms are ropes, not a crane. Let the power come from your legs and hips and keep your arms long until you've fully extended.
Wie de heupen niet helemaal doorstrekt,: If you don't fully extend your hips, you lose speed. Push through the floor until your ankles, knees and hips are extended, and only then drop under the bar.
Veel lifters trekken de stang hoog en wa: Many lifters pull the bar high and wait for it to come down. Dropping under the bar fast is half the lift. Practise it with an empty bar or a PVC pipe.
